title: fix(plugin-grid,plugin-detail,plugin-dashboard,plugin-list,fields): withhold an untyped column until the object field types are known (objectui#10657)
body:
Fixes #10657

Clause-②: yes

PR 2 of 2 for objectui#10657, the masked-column closure card. PR 1 (objectui#10725, landed as `9c78ebe`) made the three producers set `TableColumn.masked`. This PR carries the two rows the release comment `5852410452` left: the first paint before the object schema settles (the folded objectui#10706 row), and the same draw window at `RelatedList` and `ObjectDataTable`.

Branch `claude/issue-10657-masked-first-paint`, base objectui `origin/main` `c907a9c87`, head `9f9b8b7`. Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY` for the PM claim `5856905742`.

## What changed

**Withheld columns (the triage's "for every other case").** While an object-bound producer's field types are unknown (its definition read is in flight, or it failed), a column it cannot type is drawn as the mask (`MaskedCellRenderer`) and carries `masked`. It stays so when the read fails: fail closed, never back to text.

- `ObjectGrid` (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`). `objectTypesPending` is true when there is an object name, the data source can answer `getObjectSchema`, and no field catalogue is in hand. An untyped column (no authored `type`) on any of the three column paths (authored `ListColumn`s, bare field names, host row keys) is withheld. No heuristic type is inferred for it, and its cell is the mask. `isMaskedGridColumn` takes a third, required argument, so the masked flag, the grid's client export (CSV and JSON), the mobile card and the grouping refusal all treat a withheld column as masked. A column that authors its own `type` draws from it, as before.
  - The group label follows the cell: a grouping entry on a withheld key is refused, like a masked key, until the types are known. That refusal is not warned; the masked-field warning still names a known masked key.
  - A failed inline read is still non-fatal for the rows. Its comment no longer claims the columns fall back to heuristics.
  - The record panel a row opens under overlay navigation, with no declared fields in hand, drew every value of the record by inference. In the same window it now draws each value as the mask.
- `RelatedList` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`). This list draws cells from the object's types only (`makeCell`), never from an authored `type`. So in its window (`objectTypesPending`, from PR 1), every column without a `cell` of its own gets the mask as its `cell`, at the one seam into the table (`tableColumns`). An author-supplied `cell` draws what it returns.
- `ObjectDataTable` (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`). In its window, a column with no authored `type` gets the mask as its `cell`, and a column with an authored `type` draws from it. Its record drill-down drawer (`RecordDetailDrawer`, internal) takes the table's `objectTypesPending` and draws every value as the mask in that window.

**No window where the host already holds the types (the triage's first shape).** `ListView` (`@object-ui/plugin-list`) reads the object definition before it fetches the rows (the data fetch waits for `objectDefLoaded`). It now hands the definition's `fields` to the grid as the `objectFields` React prop, beside `data`. The grid answers field-type questions from that catalogue until its own read lands. Only the grid view is handed it.

**The mask's owner exports it.** `@object-ui/fields` now exports `MaskedCellRenderer`, with `field` optional. The three producers draw a withheld cell with the one mask the fields package owns and do not restate the glyph. That is the reason PR 1's review gave for keeping the mask's drawing out of `components`.

## Mechanism assumptions (Zone 2), measured

- **B1: confirmed** at base `c907a9c87`.
  - On the inline path `objectSchema` starts `null`, and untyped columns take their type from it or from `inferColumnType`.
  - The inline fetch effect's `catch` swallows a failed `getObjectSchema` ("Schema fetch failure for inline data is non-fatal").
  - The grid-fetch path reads the schema before its rows and shows a failed read as the error panel, so that path has no draw window.
- **B2: confirmed.** PR 1's `objectTypesPending` stamps every column in both producers, and neither producer attached a cell in that window. `RelatedList`'s `makeCell` needs a definition, and `ObjectDataTable`'s `renderFieldValue` got no type. So the table drew the value.
- **B3: this branch adds no textual overlap with PR objectui#10278.**
  - Each of its nine `ObjectGrid.tsx` hunks was checked, context by context, against this branch's base and head. Eight match on both.
  - Its `-2349` hunk already misses on `origin/main` `c907a9c87`, before this branch: main moved under that draft.
  - Its `plugin-grid` README hunk matches on both.
- **B4: no existing grid input carried the types.** The narrowest input is a new optional React prop, `objectFields` on `ObjectGridComponentProps`.
  - It reuses the runtime-only channel that decision batch #70 ruled for the object's field catalogue. `SchemaRenderer` already strips an AUTHORED `objectFields` in all three spellings (objectui#8818), so no view author can hand the grid a catalogue that types a credential field as text.
  - A new name, such as passing the whole `objectSchema`, would have been spread from authored metadata straight into the grid.
  - So `Clause-②: yes` holds: this adds a new optional prop to a published component's props type, and a new export to `@object-ui/fields`.

## Design choices, stated

- **"Draw it as unknown" draws the mask.** A skeleton would claim the row is still loading after a failed read, and an em-dash would claim the value is empty. The mask is the face this product already uses for "a value is here and is not shown".
  - The cost: while a host that does not hand the types is waiting, untyped columns flash as masks, and after a failed read they stay masks.
  - `RelatedList` and `ObjectDataTable` already paid PR 1's stated cost in that window (no copy, tooltip, export or sort). Now the cells are masked too.
- **A withheld grouping key is refused, not grouped under masked labels.** Masked labels would still bucket the records that share a value, which is objectui#10583's own reason for refusing a masked key.

## Beyond the claimed file surface (stated, not silent)

- **The mask export.** `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, `packages/fields/README.md` and a `minor` changeset: the `MaskedCellRenderer` export, from the mask's owner.
- **The same window one click further.** `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/RecordDetailDrawer.tsx`, and the grid's record panel inside `ObjectGrid.tsx`, outside the column-type region.
  - This is a bounded in-place fix: the same defect class, the same withheld shape and pins, files in the packages this claim already holds, and the same gate family.
  - The claim's file surface should be amended to carry them.
- **Forced prose.** `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` (JSDoc only), `content/docs/components/complex/data-table.mdx`, and the grid, detail and dashboard READMEs. Their text said an untyped column is still drawn as text in this window, and this change makes that false.
- **Existing pins edited: 8 files (9 case bodies, one shared wait helper, one fixture).** Each read an untyped cell's raw value INSIDE the window this card withholds, as a readiness signal or as a control. Each now waits for the mask or for the settled draw, and each keeps its own claim:
  - `authoredColumnsFls-6799`, `inlineDataFls-6723`: the in-flight case waits for the mask.
  - `hostFetchedDefaultColumns-6677`: the two in-flight cases wait for the mask.
  - `RelatedList.maskedColumn-10657`: the settled wait also requires the drawn name, and the two fail-closed cases wait for the mask.
  - `ObjectDataTable.maskedColumn-10657`: the fail-closed fixture's `Name` column authors `type: 'text'`, so it still draws. That file pins the flag, which still stamps every column.
  - `ObjectDataTable.fetchGate-10664`: the thrown-read case waits for the mask.
  - `RelatedList.multiValueParentScope-7299`: the thrown-read case counts the one parent-scoped row by its mask.
  - `RecordRelatedListRenderer.unresolvedIdentityFailClosed-8793`: the census case waits for the settled draw.
- **Pending changesets this supersedes.** The pending objectui#10583 changeset and four pending objectui#10657 changesets (grid, related list, `object-data-table`, types) describe the window as uncovered or as drawing text. The overwrite gate forbids editing them, so each new changeset says which of those sentences no longer holds.

## Pins (new)

- **`plugin-grid`, `maskedFirstPaint-10657` (8 cases).** Held, rejected, settled, host catalogue, group label (held and rejected), and the record panel. Each case has `Name` beside it, a column that authors `type: 'text'` and so draws, tooltips and copies in every arm.
- **`plugin-detail`, `RelatedList.maskedFirstPaint-10657` (6 cases).** Held, rejected and settled, over bare-name and authored-object columns, beside an author-supplied `cell` column.
- **`plugin-dashboard`, `ObjectDataTable.maskedFirstPaint-10657` (6 cases).** Held, rejected (inline and fetched rows), auto-derived, settled, and the record drawer, beside a column that authors `type: 'text'`.
- **`plugin-list`, `ListView.gridObjectFields-10657` (2 cases).** Every props bag that hands the grid rows also carries the declared fields. The control: after a failed definition read, the rows arrive with no catalogue.

**Ablation.** One run, restored by a trap.
- **Mutation.** The seven source files were checked out at `c907a9c87`. The fix markers (`objectTypesPending`, `withheldCell`, the `objectFields` handoff, the `MaskedCellRenderer` export) read 0 on disk, and every blob equalled its base blob.
- **Red.** The four new pin files gave `Test Files 4 failed (4)` and `Tests 20 failed | 1 passed (21)`. The one pass is the ListView control arm.
- **Restore.** The files were restored from `HEAD`: `git diff HEAD` was empty, every blob equalled its `HEAD` blob, and the same run gave `Tests 21 passed (21)`.
- The pins reach the packages through the vitest source aliases, so no build was involved.

## Verification

All runs went through the shared verify lock. Head-pinned; `9f9b8b7` differs from `e8503d3` by one changeset file only.

- **Package suites at `e8503d3`.**
  - `plugin-grid`: `Test Files 163 passed (163)`, `Tests 1525 passed (1525)`.
  - `plugin-dashboard`: `Test Files 138 passed (138)`, `Tests 1290 passed (1290)`.
  - `plugin-detail`: `Test Files 215 passed | 1 skipped (216)`, `Tests 2108 passed | 8 skipped (2116)`.
- **Package suites at `e742e22`.** The sources of these two packages are unchanged since the first commit.
  - `plugin-list`: `Test Files 103 passed (103)`, `Tests 1171 passed (1171)`.
  - `fields`: `Test Files 214 passed | 1 skipped (215)`, `Tests 3453 passed | 7 skipped (3460)`.
- **Downstream consumers at `e742e22`.** Every test file outside the four producer packages (and outside `types`, `core`, `fields`, `components`, `scripts`) that names these components and `getObjectSchema`: `Test Files 96 passed (96)`, `Tests 1680 passed (1680)`.
- **Type-check at `e8503d3`.** `turbo run type-check` for `fields`, `types`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-detail` and `plugin-dashboard`: `Tasks: 21 successful, 21 total`, with each package's `type-check` script echoed and no `error TS`. Each package's `tsconfig.test.json` lists its new pin (`--listFiles`, 1 hit x4).
- **Lint, narrowed, at `e8503d3`.** eslint on the 20 changed TS files gave 0 errors.
  - Per-file warnings equal the base for every pre-existing file except `ListView.tsx`, which goes from 184 to 185 (`react-hooks/refs`). The new read of `viewComponentSchema.type` carries the same finding that the existing `schema={viewComponentSchema}` read already carries. Warnings do not gate here.
  - The narrowing is a measurement: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware; the population is the changed files from the diff against `c907a9c87`; the count of 20 is read from the JSON output.
- **Gates, exit 0 at `9f9b8b7` or `e8503d3`.**
  - `check-changeset-presence`: "20 source file(s) of 6 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 6 changeset(s)".
  - `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`.
  - `check-changeset-overwrite`: "No pre-existing changeset was modified or deleted".
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`.
  - `check:new-line-citations`: "0 new citation(s)".
  - `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`.
  - `check-doc-links`: "Links are valid across 17 scan roots".
  - `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-types`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`.
  - `check:changeset-claims` (report-only).
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 31 paths: "NOT GOVERNED".
- **NOT MEASURED.**
  - `check:doc-snippets`: it exited 2 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because its 34-package build did not run here; CI builds it. For that reason the grid README states the new prop in prose rather than in an uncompiled snippet.
  - `check:readme-exports`: it exited 1 with "self-import(s) could not be judged" for unbuilt packages. The new `fields` README import resolves against the built `fields` dist.
  - A browser check of the mask under the real console.

## Acceptance notes (not in this PR)

- `RelatedList`'s own opt-in filter box and its `list` sort buttons read raw values (objectui#10728, ordered after this card).
- The `data-table` header context menu ignores `sortable: false`.
- `RelatedList`'s other bodies are not the data-table seam and were not measured for this window: the mobile `object-gallery` card view and `type: 'list'` (`data-list`).
- A `prefix` compound cell on the grid draws its prefix field as a badge or as text whatever that field's type. This is an authored presentation, the same boundary as an authored `type: 'text'` over a `secret` field, in the settled state too.
- A column that authors `type: 'text'` over a `secret` field draws its text in the window, as it does once settled. Its flag in the grid's window follows the authored type until the object's type is known.
